programme.title: #IkLome / #LIKEME
programme.desc: The last day of school of a very turbulent school year. After everything that has been said on the school ball, nobody's life will be the same anymore. Na alles wat er op het schoolbal gezegd is geweest zal niemands leven meer hetzelfde zijn. Caro en Peter hebben een moeilijke beslissing genomen en het is tijd om afscheid te nemen.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Arno is disappointed that he has to study again. He would love to be rich, then he no longer has to go to school and never do homework. When he wakes up one morning, Jackie and Geert have good news for Arno. He won the Lotto. Arnos big dream finally came true. He is rich and no longer has to go to school. But is that really fun as he thought? / Arno baalt dat hij weeral moet studeren. Hij zou zo graag rijk zijn, dan moet hij niet meer naar school en nooit nog huiswerk maken. Wanneer hij op een ochtend wakker wordt, hebben Jackie en Geert goed nieuws voor Arno. Hij heeft de lotto gewonnen. Arnos grote droom is eindelijk uitgekomen. Hij is rijk en hoeft niet meer naar school. Maar is dat wel echt zo leuk als hij dacht?

programme.title: Flikken Maastricht / Flikken Maastricht
programme.desc: The director of a stay of my bodyhouse is murdered. All men for whom the women have fled are suspected, but Wolfs and Eva soon discover that more is going on. Romeos Syriagoer shows mysterious behavior and Romeo reports this to the AIVD. Despite Marion's warning to leave it to the services, Romeo goes after the men on his own. / De directrice van een Blijf van mijn lijfhuis wordt vermoord. Alle mannen waarvoor de vrouwen gevlucht zijn, worden verdacht, maar Wolfs en Eva ontdekken al snel dat er meer speelt. Romeos Syriëganger vertoont geheimzinnig gedrag en Romeo rapporteert dat aan de AIVD. Ondanks de waarschuwing van Marion om het aan de diensten over te laten, gaat Romeo op eigen houtje achter de mannen aan.

programme.title: Travel Waes: De Bucketlist / Reizen Waes: de bucketlist
programme.desc: For years, El Salvador was far too dangerous for tourists and also for Waes travel. Drug gangs had the country completely in their grip and made El Salvador one of the most dangerous countries in the world. Until the current president, Nayib Bukele, came to power. Tom goes to El Salvador to discover if you can travel around safely and what you can experience there. / Jarenlang was El Salvador veel te gevaarlijk voor toeristen en ook voor Reizen Waes. Drugsbendes hadden het land volledig in hun greep en maakten van El Salvador een van de gevaarlijkste landen ter wereld. Tot de huidige president, Nayib Bukele, aan de macht kwam. Tom trekt naar El Salvador om te ontdekken of je er veilig kan rondreizen en wat je er allemaal kan beleven.

programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 1944, Arnout Marlene meets Dietrich in the headquarters of General Patton. She just fled from Bastogne, where she performed for American soldiers. programme.desc: Master Frans asks the kids to make a work about how they see their future. Arno is convinced that he will invent the talking dog and will become stinking, Mo sees himself playing all the big film roles as an actor, Esra believes that she will become a real wizard, Jackie is sure she will build a rocket that Daria can bring to Mars and Geert ... who always wants everything to stay the same. programme.title: Animal doctor 24/7 / Dierendokters 24/7
programme.desc: Rubini is a 20-year-old breeding mare. She has already gave birth to many foals, but this time things go wrong. The foal is dead in the womb with both front and hind legs in the birth canal. It will be a tough challenge to get the foal out of the mare. In the cutting room of the Morphology department, the students of the second bachelor receive a challenging assignment. They must dissect a cat and find and prepare the organs and structures according to a step -by -step plan. In the center of Ghent, the veterinarians and students of the faculty are also running the dispensary. It is a small first -line clinic for small pets. It was founded for people who cannot pay for normal veterinary care for their pet. / Rubini is een 20-jarige fokmerrie. Ze heeft al veel veulens op de wereld gezet, maar deze keer gaat het mis. Het veulen zit dood in de baarmoeder met zowel voor- als achterbenen in het geboortekanaal. Het wordt een zware uitdaging om het veulen uit de merrie te krijgen. In de snijzaal van de afdeling Morfologie krijgen de studenten van het tweede bachelor een uitdagende opdracht. Ze moeten een kat dissecteren en volgens een stappenplan de organen en structuren terugvinden en prepareren. In het centrum van Gent wordt door de dierenartsen en studenten van de faculteit ook het Dispensarium uitgebaat. Het is een kleine eerstelijnskliniek voor kleine huisdieren. Het werd opgericht voor mensen die de normale diergeneeskundige zorg voor hun huisdier niet kunnen betalen.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live off their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauty of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: In the background of social rebellions and class struggles in Italy just before World War I, two passionate love stories and one great story of the victim are intertwined. Carrara, 1913, the young Brando works in the marble mine in Colonnati, owned by engineer Corradi. Brando is an idealist who struggles to improve the dug working conditions. A serious accident that happens to a miner takes him to the Holy Crown Hospital led by the honorable mother Agnese. At that point, the suffering meets Silvia, who volunteers as a nurse. The brand immediately touches the deep humanity of a young woman, and later returned to the hospital to meet her again. Among the attraction, they feel they share the same ideals. Leopoldo Corradi, the most influential person in the city, suggested to his son Corrad to run for MP Carrara, making her first son Albert. Young housekeeper Maddalena, a sister's brand, is under sharp and constant criticism of Mrs. Maffei, who rejects her permit for Maddalena's free evening so that she can celebrate her birthday with the family. The brand overwhelms the anger for this new act of abuse, goes to the Corradi villa, and reveals that Silvia is, in fact, the wife of his boss Corrad Corradi. Roots: Francesca Valtort, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree NoFereini, Federica de Benedittis / U pozadini društvenih pobuna i klasnih borbi u Italiji malo prije Prvog svjetskog rata prepleću se dvije strastvene ljubavne priče i jedna velika priča o žrtvi.Carrara, 1913., mladi Brando radi u rudniku mramora u Colonnati, čiji je vlasnik inženjer Corradi. Brando je idealista koji se bori da poboljša uvjete rada kopača. Teška nesreća koja se dogodi jednom rudaru odvede ga u bolnicu Sveta Kruna koju vodi časna majka Agnese. Na tom mjestu patnji upoznaje Silviju, koja volontira kao medicinska sestra. Branda smjesta dirne duboka ljudskost mlade žene, te se on naknadno vrati u bolnicu kako bi je ponovno susreo. Među, pored privlačnosti, oni osjete da dijele iste ideale. Leopoldo Corradi, najutjecajnija osoba u gradu, predloži svom sinu Corradu da se kandidira za zastupnika okruga Carrara, čime naljuti svog prvog sina Alberta. Mlada kućna pomoćnica Maddalena, Brandova sestra,pod oštrim je i stalnim kritikama gđice Maffei, koja joj odbije dozvolu za Maddalenino slobodno veče, kako bi mogla proslaviti svoj rođendan sa porodicom. Branda obuzima gnjev zbog tog novog čina zlostavljanja, odlazi u vilu Corradijevih, a tamo otkrije da je Silvia, zapravo, žena njegovog gazde Corrada Corradija. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Lincoln: In the shadow of division / Lincoln: U sjeni podjela
programme.desc: Just before the assassination, Lincoln is transformed from the controversial figure on the rudder the largest crisis in America, to the hero of martyrs. After his brutal murder, in this episode of hunting on his killer, his knowledge of his wife and the state he left behind. America is full of racial conflicts, and its murder launches a hundred-year struggle for civil rights, from Jim Crow to the Movement "Black Lives Matter". Lincoln is marked as a lifeguard and hero, he was turned into a myth, but reality is much more complex. If he must be believed that he represents what is the state, people then have to see his evolution that will inspire everything to learn, develop and change, as he did. / Neposredno prije atentata, Lincoln se preobražava iz kontroverzne figure na kormilu najveće krize u Americi, do heroja mučenika. Nakon njegovog brutalnog ubistva, u ovoj epizodi o lovu na njegovog ubicu, saznanjima o njegovoj supruzi i državi koju je ostavio iza sebe. Amerika je prepuna rasnih sukoba, a njegovo ubistvo pokreće stogodišnju borbu za građanska prava, od Jima Crowa do pokreta "Black Lives Matter". Lincoln je označen kao spasilac i heroj, pretvoren je u mit, ali stvarnost je mnogo kompleksnija. Ako se mora vjerovati da on predstavlja ono što je država, ljudi onda moraju sagledati njegovu evoluciju koja će inspirisati sve da uče, razvijaju i mijenjaju se, kao što je on to radio.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: In the background of social rebellions and class struggles in Italy just before World War I, two passionate love stories and one great story of the victim are intertwined. Carrara, 1913, the young Brando works in the marble mine in Colonnati, owned by engineer Corradi. Brando is an idealist who struggles to improve the dug working conditions. A serious accident that happens to a miner takes him to the Holy Crown Hospital led by the honorable mother Agnese. At that point, the suffering meets Silvia, who volunteers as a nurse. The brand immediately touches the deep humanity of a young woman, and later returned to the hospital to meet her again. Among the attraction, they feel they share the same ideals. Leopoldo Corradi, the most influential person in the city, suggested to his son Corrad to run for MP Carrara, making her first son Albert. Young housekeeper Maddalena, a sister's brand, is under sharp and constant criticism of Mrs. Maffei, who rejects her permit for Maddalena's free evening so that she can celebrate her birthday with the family. The brand overwhelms the anger for this new act of abuse, goes to the Corradi villa, and reveals that Silvia is, in fact, the wife of his boss Corrad Corradi. Roots: Francesca Valtort, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree NoFereini, Federica de Benedittis / U pozadini društvenih pobuna i klasnih borbi u Italiji malo prije Prvog svjetskog rata prepleću se dvije strastvene ljubavne priče i jedna velika priča o žrtvi.Carrara, 1913., mladi Brando radi u rudniku mramora u Colonnati, čiji je vlasnik inženjer Corradi. Brando je idealista koji se bori da poboljša uvjete rada kopača. Teška nesreća koja se dogodi jednom rudaru odvede ga u bolnicu Sveta Kruna koju vodi časna majka Agnese. Na tom mjestu patnji upoznaje Silviju, koja volontira kao medicinska sestra. Branda smjesta dirne duboka ljudskost mlade žene, te se on naknadno vrati u bolnicu kako bi je ponovno susreo. Među, pored privlačnosti, oni osjete da dijele iste ideale. Leopoldo Corradi, najutjecajnija osoba u gradu, predloži svom sinu Corradu da se kandidira za zastupnika okruga Carrara, čime naljuti svog prvog sina Alberta. Mlada kućna pomoćnica Maddalena, Brandova sestra,pod oštrim je i stalnim kritikama gđice Maffei, koja joj odbije dozvolu za Maddalenino slobodno veče, kako bi mogla proslaviti svoj rođendan sa porodicom. Branda obuzima gnjev zbog tog novog čina zlostavljanja, odlazi u vilu Corradijevih, a tamo otkrije da je Silvia, zapravo, žena njegovog gazde Corrada Corradija. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

programme.desc: Ogda and a suffered poet Aleksa Šantić, trying to write his life of the French writer Anri Korbijer, to remember his life, in Mostar on Brankovac, Aleks, to take with him, through his life, pictures of the then exciting historical Events: Bloody Hamzić's rebellion, the arrival of the AustroGroad Army. "Middle People _ No people", the teacher's thought he took for his whole life. Draga: Branislav Lečić, Boris Milivojević, Tanasije Uzunović, Nada Đurevska, Uroš Kravljača, Boro Stjepanović. Screenwriter: Djordje Lebović and Josip Lešić Director: Aleksandar Jevđević / Ostarjeli i oboljeli pjesnik Aleksa Šantić, pokušavajući da napiše svoju životnu maksimu koju je od njega zatražio francuski književnik Anri Korbijer, želeći da ona bude "dovoljno mudra i istinita", počinje da se sjeća svog života.U velikoj i bogatoj kući Šantića, u Mostaru na Brankovcu, Aleksa, dječak od osam godina, ponijeće sa sobom, kroz život, slike tadašnjih uzbudljivih istorijskih zbivanja: krvavu Hamzićevu bunu, dolazak austrougraske vojske. Kada je stigao do škole, adža Miho ga vodi u Trst, a zatim u Ljubljanu na trgovačku akademiju. U Trstu Aleksa otkriva novi svijet, ali najveći uticaj na njega imao je učitelj Ljudevit Vuličević. On će mu pomoći da zavoli poeziju, da dobije osnovne pojmove o panslavizmu, domovini, ljepoti. "Srednji ljudi _ nikakvi ljudi", učiteljeva je misao koju je ponio za cijeli život.Uloge: Branislav Lečić, Boris Milivojević, Tanasije Uzunović, Nada Đurevska, Uroš Kravljača, Boro Stjepanović. programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Крег Дугъл Маклалън е в ролята на доктор Лусиен Блейк, който се завръща в Баларат, северозападно от Мелбърн, в края на 1950-те години, за да поеме общата медицинска практика на покойния си баща и ролята на полицейски хирург след отсъствие от 30 години. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. programme.title: Tennis: Davis Cup: Match 1: USA - Czech Republic / Тенис: Купа Дейвис: Мач 1: САЩ - Чехия
programme.desc: The tournament was established in 1900 at the initiative of American tennis player Dwight Davis, with the first edition being a meeting between the US and the UK. Gradually, the race is growing and today is among the largest sporting events with the participation of many countries around the world. Each clash is held in format up to three wins from five matches - on the first day two singles are played, and in the second one follows a match in pairs and two reverse singles. Since 2019, the structure of the tournament has been upgraded and already includes qualification stages, group phase and final eight, in which the top eight teams argue for the award. / Турнирът е създаден през 1900 г. по инициатива на американския тенисист Дуайт Дейвис, като първото издание е било среща между САЩ и Великобритания. Постепенно надпреварата се разраства и днес е сред най-мащабните спортни събития с участие на множество държави от целия свят. Всеки сблъсък се провежда във формат до три победи от пет срещи – в първия ден се изиграват два сингъла, а във втория следват мач по двойки и два обратни сингъла. От 2019 г. структурата на турнира е модернизирана, като вече включва квалификационни етапи, групова фаза и финална осмица, в която най-добрите осем отбора спорят за отличието.

programme.title: Football: Elite Champions League of Asia: Round 1: Al Sharja - Al Garafa / Футбол: Елитна Шампионска лига на Азия: 1 кръг: Ал Шарджа - Ал Гарафа
programme.desc: The Elite Champions League of Asia is a football club competition, featuring the best clubs from Asian football leagues, organized under the auspices of AFC. This is the most important club football competition on the continent and is the equivalent of the European Champions League. By the fall of 2024, the tournament was taken as the AFC Champions League of Asia, but from that moment the race was renamed to the elite Champions League of Asia / Елитната Шампионска лига на Азия е футболно клубно състезание, в което участват най-добрите клубове от азиатските футболни лиги, организирано под егидата на АФК . Това е най-важното клубно футболно състезание на континента и е еквивалент на Европейската шампионска лига. До есента на 2024 г. турнирът е извстен като АФК Шампионска лига на Азия, но от този момент надпреварата е преименувана на Елитна Шампионска лига на Азия

programme.title: Tennis: Davis Cup: Match 5: USA - Czech Republic / Тенис: Купа Дейвис: Мач 5: САЩ - Чехия
programme.desc: The tournament was established in 1900 at the initiative of American tennis player Dwight Davis, with the first edition being a meeting between the US and the UK. Gradually, the race is growing and today is among the largest sporting events with the participation of many countries around the world. Each clash is held in format up to three wins from five matches - on the first day two singles are played, and in the second one follows a match in pairs and two reverse singles. Since 2019, the structure of the tournament has been upgraded and already includes qualification stages, group phase and final eight, in which the top eight teams argue for the award. / Турнирът е създаден през 1900 г. по инициатива на американския тенисист Дуайт Дейвис, като първото издание е било среща между САЩ и Великобритания. Постепенно надпреварата се разраства и днес е сред най-мащабните спортни събития с участие на множество държави от целия свят. Всеки сблъсък се провежда във формат до три победи от пет срещи – в първия ден се изиграват два сингъла, а във втория следват мач по двойки и два обратни сингъла. От 2019 г. структурата на турнира е модернизирана, като вече включва квалификационни етапи, групова фаза и финална осмица, в която най-добрите осем отбора спорят за отличието.

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E24, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E24, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Veljko from the sea / Veljko od mora
programme.desc: Veljko from the sea - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2023) Veljko Rogosic ... The one swimming around the world, with sharks and dolphins, rebuilding records and advertising juices and wine, star in an unattractive sport such as a remote swim, 203 times the Yugoslav national team, winner of the medal at many championships, a man who knocked down the national records 147 times. And the one who cares that somewhere in the open sea, competes with himself. He won the world championship four times, seven times he was named the best marathon of the world, is a multiple world record holder in a remote swim. In his sports treasury at the house in Kastel Luksic, there are more than 1450 cups, medals, plaques, diplomas and recognitions. This is a portrait of a swimmer who swam the world 8 times, Dalmatian, a good father and grandfather. Sam calculated that he spent almost a third of his life in the seas, lakes and rivers. He made so much solem that, if everyone was added up, he could sail the world eight times. And therefore, it is no wonder that he was called by a man of fish, a sea man, a sea wolf, a dolphin, a catamaran ... As many as 142 times he was a national champion in various disciplines, and the national records had been over 51 times! He is probably a world record holder by the number of advertisements recorded. He is the holder of the headline "King of Cold Water" (1976), "a resident" is a swimming house of the famous Florida (1992), entered the Guinness Book of Records, swirling 225 kilometers without getting out of the water on the route of Gradacine (2006). He won in the Italian Riccione, where he won the first world champion title. He was the best at the marathons in Saguenay, Alexandria, Sydney, Cook's passage, Mar del Plate and on Lake Ontario, where he also set a world record. The news of his sub -tests stood in two sentences of the sports section of the diary, after which positive energy, the breath of victory, the thought of which these unknown toponyms would be breaths, which brings Veljko to the miraculous way. World Marathon Plivari Federation (WPMSF) ... / Veljko od mora - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Veljko Rogošić... Onaj što pliva oko svijeta, s morskim psima i dupinima, što obara rekorde i reklamira sokove i vino, zvijezda u neatraktivnom sportu kakav je daljinsko plivanje, 203 puta reprezentativac Jugoslavije, osvajač medalja na mnogim prvenstvima, čovjek koji je 147 puta rušio državne rekorde i snimio 127 reklama. I onaj kome je stalo da se, negdje na pučini, natječe sam sa sobom. Četiri puta okitio se naslovom svjetskog prvaka, sedam puta proglašen je najboljim maratoncem svijeta, višestruki je svjetski rekorder u daljinskom plivanju. U njegovoj sportskoj riznici u kući u Kaštel Lukšiću više je od 1450 pehara, medalja, plaketa, diploma i priznanja. Ovo je portret plivača koji je 8 puta preplivao svijet, Dalmatinca, dobrog oca i djeda. Sam je izračunao da je u morima, jezerima i rijekama proveo gotovo trećinu života. Napravio je toliko zaveslaja da bi, kada bi se svi zbrojili, mogao osam puta oploviti svijet. I stoga nije čudno što su ga zvali čovjek riba, morski čovik, morski vuk, dupin, katamaran... Čak 142 puta je bio državni prvak u raznim disciplinama, a državne je rekorde obarao čak 51 put! Vjerojatno je i svjetski rekorder po broju snimljenih reklama. Nositelj je naslova "Kralj hladnih voda" (1976.), "stanovnik" je plivačke Kuće slavnih na Floridi (1992.), ušao je u Guinnessovu knjigu rekorda, preplivavši 225 kilometara ne izlazeći iz vode na relaciji Grado - Riccione (2006.). Pobjeđivao je u talijanskom Riccioneu, gde je osvojio prvu titulu svjetskog prvaka. Bio je najbolji na maratonima u Saguenayu, Aleksandriji, Sydneyju, Cookovom prolazu, Mar del Plati i na jezeru Ontario, gde je postavio i svjetski rekord. Vijesti o njegovim podvizima stale su u dvije rečenice sportske rubrike Dnevnika, poslije kojih bi prostrujali pozitivna energija, dah pobjede, misao o tome gde su ti nepoznati toponimi koje svojim zaveslajima Veljko spaja na čudesan način. programme.title: Great American journey Sue Perkins / Veliko američko putovanje Sue Perkins
programme.desc: Sue Perkins Big American Road Trip - (E01, Tourism Program, England, 2022) This is a good view of the modern American phenomenon of life in the caravan. Sue was never one of those who often camped, but she always dreamed of a life spent outdoors and on the move, about sitting at the steering wheel, squeezing gas and looking at where the way would take her. She will not be enough for the experience of traveling by the road. He has to expand the horizons and go on a trip through the two most beautiful US states, Colorado and California, in his own camper, to discover all the benefits and flaws of life on the road. In America, more than a million people have moved on to this completely new way of life and replaced their homes for homes on wheels, so they wander to cult landscapes and use social media, motivating other passengers. Sue wants to try out that lifestyle first -hand and get to know the people whose life in the caravan has become the only thing they need, some who have been forced to do so and some who wanted it - from those who did not realize the American dream after all their life of painstaking work, to those who seek adventures, freedom and exit from the gungle ... and all between all this. ------ join Sue Perkins at the first section of her Odysseus in Camper as she travels to the golden state of California, attractive to every adventure of the road trip, with vineyards, legendary routes, high forests and a magnificent coast. At the steering wheel of their new home, the legendary Pacific coast highway and meets Blix and Bess, a couple who left their established life less than a year ago - a new generation of caravan residents, with a new attitude towards life on a movement, remaining networked and employed while enjoying freedom of wandering. Sue goes on to interior to one of the most famous national parks in the US, Yosemitea, and meets Alexandri - one of the first young solitary lonely who joined the movement of life in Karavan. R .: Erin Heidenreich Ul.: Sue Perkins (Self - Present) ... / Sue Perkins Big American Road Trip - (E01, turistički program, Engleska, 2022) Ovo je dobronamjeran pogled na moderni američki fenomen života u karavanu. Sue nikad nije bila od onih što često kampiraju, ali je uvijek maštala o životu provedenom na otvorenom i u pokretu, o tome da sjedne za upravljač, stisne gas i gleda kamo će je put odvesti. Za doživljaj putovanja cestom vožnja po A1 neće joj biti dovoljna. Mora proširiti horizonte i poći na put kroz dvije najljepše američke države, Colorado i Kaliforniju, u vlastitom kamperu, da otkrije sve prednosti i mane života na cesti. U Americi je više od milijun ljudi prešlo na taj posve novi način života i zamijenilo svoje kuće za domove na kotačima pa lutaju kultnim krajolicima i služe se društvenim medijima motivirajući i druge putnike. Sue želi iz prve ruke iskušati taj životni stil i upoznati ljude kojima je život u karavanu postao jedino što im treba, neke koji su na to bili prisiljeni i neke koji su to htjeli - od onih kojima se američki san nije ostvario nakon cijelog života mukotrpnog rada, do onih koji traže pustolovine, slobodu i izlaz iz gungule... i sve između svega toga. ----- Pridružite se Sue Perkins na prvome odsječku njezine odiseje u kamperu dok putuje zlatnom državom Kalifornijom, privlačnom svakom pustolovu cestovnog putovanja, s vinogradima, legendarnim rutama, visokim šumama i veličanstvenom obalom. Za upravljačem svojega novog doma Sue vozi legendarnom autocestom Pacifičke obale te upozna Blix i Bess, par koji je napustio svoj ustaljeni život prije manje od godinu dana - novu generaciju stanovnika karavana, s novim stavom prema životu u pokretu, pri čemu ostaju umrežene i zaposlene, dok uživaju u slobodi lutanja. Sue dalje nastavlja prema unutrašnjosti do jednog od najpoznatijih nacionalnih parkova u SAD-u, Yosemitea, i upoznaje Alexandriju - jednu od prvih mladih samotnjakinja koje su se pridružile pokretu života u karavanu. R.: Erin Heidenreich Ul.: Sue Perkins (Self - Presenter)...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E25, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E25, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E25, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E25, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi
programme.desc: The Goldbergs-(S09, E02, Comedy, USA, 2021) Once not so long ago and not so far, 11-year-old Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) has documented his parents' life in the 1980s periphery. She has full hands of work, starting with Mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), who is well-meaning but choke him, through the temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to the rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orranti) and the hypersensible brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And there is also a reasons grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when it comes to more beautiful things in life. Driving watches, first jobs, applications for college and acquiring new friends without losing their old ones, it's all part of the Goldberg family. Some leave their childhood behind them in search of the first kiss, others are tormented by the upbringing of teenagers or, faced with aging, remember the youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience all that. Both in good and evil, they are always there for each other. R .: Lew Schneider Ul.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambron (Adam Goldberg), Troy Geldberg, Hayley Orranti (Eric Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz) ... / The Goldbergs - (S09, E02, komedija, SAD, 2021) Jednom ne tako davno i ne tako daleko 11-godišnji Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) video-kamerom svojih roditelja dokumentira život na periferiji 1980-ih godina. Ima pune ruke posla, počevši od mame Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), koja je dobronamjerna, ali ga guši, preko temperamentnog tate Murrayja (Jeff Garlin), do buntovne starije sestre Erice (Hayley Orrantia) i hipersenzibilnog brata Barryja (Troy Gentile). A tu je i raspojasani djed (George Segal), zavodnik, koji je Adamu mentor kad su posrijedi ljepše stvari u životu. Satovi vožnje, prvi poslovi, prijave za fakultet i stjecanje novih prijatelja, a da se pritom ne izgube stari, sve je to dio sage o obitelji Goldberg. programme.title: We discover Croatia / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku
programme.desc: We discover Croatia - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2025) there used to be a lot of salt in Croatia in Croatia. Especially in the Middle Ages, Solane in Pag, Nin, Ston, Trogir, Rab, Krk and Cres were known. These cities were enriched thanks to the salt pans. Because of the salt, it fought. In the Roman Empire, the soldiers were paid with salt, in Latin it was called Salarium. And from there the English word for salary salary. Salt was so valuable that they called her white gold. Today, there are three salt socks in Croatia - Pag, Nin and Ston. R.: Zrinka Krešo ... / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) U Hrvatskoj je nekada na Jadranu postojalo dosta solana. Posebice u srednjem vijeku poznate su bile solane u Pagu, Ninu, Stonu, Trogiru, Rabu, Krku i Cresu. Ovi su se gradovi i obogatili zahvaljujući solanama. Zbog soli se ratovalo. U Rimskom Carstvu vojnici su bili plaćeni solju, na latinskom to se zvalo salarium. I od tuda engleska riječ za plaću salary. Sol je bila toliko vrijedna da su je zvali bijelo zlato. Danas u Hrvatskoj još postoje tri solane - Pag, Nin i Ston. R.: Zrinka Krešo...

programme.title: Sola of life / Sol života
programme.desc: Salt of Life - (E01, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2005) Salt is a natural mineral and a product needed for a life of man and livestock. The use of salt in modern life has spread to various areas in the craft and industry. Today, it's hard to imagine what Salt has meant in the past. It was a valuable product that determined the market as it is determined today by oil consumption. Her production was limited and supervised, because it was almost everywhere a state monopoly. This monopoly filled state budgets, but also encouraged smuggling and trade. Looking at the salt in the relationship with geology, chemistry, mythology, medicine, various beliefs and beliefs, therefore, observing the salt and "salt" culture, which developed with metalurgia and salt mines, sea salt and trade, mineral techniques and ways of exploiting salt miners and various forms of use of salt, we told five salty stories and emphasized the importance and sweet substances without which life is unthinkable and impossible. It is enough to emphasize that in the human body with a mass of 70 kg of 15 liters of salty liquids. Scientists and experts from different fields participate in all stories. The first story is "The Substance Favorite to the Gods," followed by "Solnah Puts", "With the taste of the sea", "in the womb of the earth" and "Salt of Life". R .: Miljenko Bukovčan ... / Sol života - (E01, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2005) Sol je prirodni mineral i proizvod potreban za život čovjeka i stoke. Upotreba soli u suvremenom životu proširila se na razna područja u obrtu i industriji. Danas je teško zamisliti što je sve u prošlosti sol značila. Ona je bila dragocjen proizvod koji je određivao tržište kao što ga danas određuje potrošnja nafte. Njezina proizvodnja bila je ograničena i nadgledala se, jer je gotovo svuda bila državni monopol. Taj monopol punio je državne proračune, ali i poticao krijumčarenje i trgovinu. Promatrajući sol u odnosu spram geologije, kemije, mitologije, medicine, raznih vjerovanja i uvjerenja, dakle, promatrajući sol i "solne" kulture, koje su se razvile uz metalurgiju i rudnike soli, morske solane i trgovinu, tehnike rudarenja i načine iskorištavanja rudnika soli te razne oblike uporabe soli, ispričali smo pet slanih priča želeći približiti i naglasiti važnost te slane, ali u njezinu nedostatku i slatke tvari bez koje je život nezamisliv i nemoguć. Dovoljno je samo naglasiti da je u ljudskom tijelu s masom od 70 kg 15 litara slanih tekućina. U svim pričama sudjeluju znanstvenici i stručnjaci s različitih područja. Prva je priča "Tvar omiljela bogovima", a slijede "Solni putevi", "S okusom mora", "U utrobi Zemlje" i "Sol života". R.: Miljenko Bukovčan...

The moon will pass in front of the sun, causing a complete eclipse. But before the collector of sounds can experience it, he decided to record a few sounds for the day. Mirta decides to go with him. In the countryside, sheep blushes in the field. The horses of the horse hit the gallopes beside them ... The fearless red ticks on the tree. He shoots them all. Suddenly, the red leaving and everything becomes darker. Everything becomes quiet ... it's an eclipse! Mirta wants to look in the sun, but the sound collector stops her. He takes a piece of cardboard and paper from his bag. The cardboard has a hole in the middle, and with this simple projector, watching the eclipse in complete silence in a safe way. Mirta doesn't really like this night in the middle of the day, so she's hugging a collector to comfort her. It begins to re -disperse ... and the bird singing again fills the trees. Bleaning lambs comes from the field. When they return home, everything is like before, and the collector of sounds creates music that goes well with the eclipse. They spent the day together in the dark ... / Skupljač zvukova - (E11, igrana serija, Hrvatska) 11. Dan u mraku Prema barometru na zidu kuhinje danas će biti poseban dan. Mjesec će proći ispred Sunca, izazivajući potpuni pomrčinu. No prije nego što to Skupljač zvukova može doživjeti, odlučio je snimiti nekoliko zvukova za taj dan. Mirta odluči poći s njim. Na selu, ovce bleje na polju. Kopita konja udaraju dok galopira kraj njih... neustrašivi crvendać cvrči na stablu. On ih sve snima. Najedanput crvendać odlazi i sve postaje tamnije. Sve postaje tiho... to je pomrčina! Mirta želi pogledati u sunce, ali Skupljač zvukova je zaustavlja. Uzima komad kartona i papir iz svoje torbe. Karton ima rupu u sredini, i s ovim jednostavnim projektorom, promatraju pomrčinu u potpunoj tišini na siguran način. Mirti se baš ne sviđa ova noć usred dana, pa je grli Skupljač kako bi je utješio. Počinje se ponovno razdanjivati... i pjev ptica ponovno ispunjava drveće. Blejanje janjadi dolazi s polja. Kad se vrate kući, sve je kao i prije, a Skupljač zvukova stvara glazbu koja dobro ide uz pomrčinu. Zajedno su proveli dan u mraku...

programme.desc: Salt of Life - (E01, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2005) Salt is a natural mineral and a product needed for a life of man and livestock. The use of salt in modern life has spread to various areas in the craft and industry. Today, it's hard to imagine what Salt has meant in the past. It was a valuable product that determined the market as it is determined today by oil consumption. Her production was limited and supervised, because it was almost everywhere a state monopoly. This monopoly filled state budgets, but also encouraged smuggling and trade. Looking at the salt in the relationship with geology, chemistry, mythology, medicine, various beliefs and beliefs, therefore, observing the salt and "salt" culture, which developed with metalurgia and salt mines, sea salt and trade, mining techniques and ways of exploiting salt miners and various forms of use of salt, we told five salty stories and emphasized the importance and sweet substances without which life is unthinkable and impossible. It is enough to emphasize that in the human body with a mass of 70 kg of 15 liters of salty liquids. Scientists and experts from different fields participate in all stories. The first story is "The Substance Favorite to the Gods," followed by "Solnah Puts", "With the taste of the sea", "in the womb of the earth" and "Salt of Life". Ona je bila dragocjen proizvod koji je određivao tržište kao što ga danas određuje potrošnja nafte. Njezina proizvodnja bila je ograničena i nadgledala se, jer je gotovo svuda bila državni monopol. Taj monopol punio je državne proračune, ali i poticao krijumčarenje i trgovinu. Dovoljno je samo naglasiti da je u ljudskom tijelu s masom od 70 kg 15 litara slanih tekućina. U svim pričama sudjeluju znanstvenici i stručnjaci s različitih područja. Prva je priča "Tvar omiljela bogovima", a slijede "Solni putevi", "S okusom mora", "U utrobi Zemlje" i "Sol života". R.: Miljenko Bukovčan...

programme.title: Blagoje Bersa: Flower, Concert performance of Opera - KD V. Lisinski / Blagoje Bersa: Oganj, koncertna izvedba opere - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: Blagoje Bersa: Oganj, Concert performance of Opera - KD V. Lisinski - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2024) The cooperation of the Croatian Radio and Television, the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb and the Vatroslav Lisinski Concert Hall in the Canconyer cycle, on January 18, 2024. Berse. The concert performance on the occasion of the 150th anniversary of the birth and 90th anniversary of the death of the composer was attended by soloists, champions of Zagreb opera-Valentina Fijacko Kobić, Stjepan Franevović, Ljubomir Puškarić, Luciano Batinić, Siniša Stork and Siniša Hapač, and the Choir and Symphony Orchestra of HRT, HRT. The performance was led by Maestro Aleksandar Markovic. Blagoje Bersa is one of the most influential Croatian composers and musical educators whose musical oeuvre and action have significantly characterized the Croatian music of the period of modern and the first half of the 20th century. Born in Dubrovnik, educated in Vienna, Zagreb, Trieste and Zadar, Opera Oganj began to compose in 1905 in Zadar and completed it in 1906 in Vienna. Although Bersa sought to be premiered in Vienna, this did not happen, so the original German libretto of Alfred Marie Willner, with the title Der Eisenhammer, translated Ferdo Zivko Miller into Croatian by leaning. It was first staged on January 12, 1911 at the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb, and the Zagreb audience, as well as criticism, welcomed the performance with enthusiasm. Antun Gustav Matos called the fire "The first artistic opera of the high and modern style created by a Croat," especially praising the "brilliant orchestral part", Josip Andrić said "standing worthy among the works that European music received them in the time of a quarter of a century ago", and Lujo Šafranek-Kavić called Bersa "inspired by the reading master who the apparatus. " The opera was performed only in 2003 at the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb. This concert performance on the occasion of the 150th anniversary of his ... / Blagoje Bersa: Oganj, koncertna izvedba opere - KD V. Lisinski - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2024) Suradnja Hrvatske radiotelevizije, Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta u Zagrebu i Koncertne dvorane Vatroslava Lisinskog u ciklusu Kanconijer, 18. siječnja 2024. iznjedrila je prvu integralnu izvedbu jednog od kapitalnih djela hrvatske glazbe 20. stoljeća - operu Oganj Blagoja Berse. U koncertnoj izvedbi u povodu 150. godišnjice rođenja i 90. godišnjice smrti skladatelja sudjelovali su solisti, prvaci zagrebačke Opere - Valentina Fijačko Kobić, Stjepan Franetović, Ljubomir Puškarić, Luciano Batinić, Siniša Štork i Siniša Hapač, te Zbor i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, Zbor HNK-a Zagreb i Dječji zbor HRT-a. Izvedbu je predvodio maestro Aleksandar Marković. Blagoje Bersa jedan je od najutjecajnijih hrvatskih skladatelja i glazbenih pedagoga čiji su glazbeni opus i djelovanje bitno obilježili hrvatsku glazbu razdoblja moderne i prve polovice 20. stoljeća. Rođen u Dubrovniku, školovan u Beču, Zagrebu, Trstu i Zadru, operu Oganj počeo je skladati 1905. u Zadru i dovršio je 1906. u Beču. Iako je Bersa nastojao da se djelo praizvede u Beču, to se nije dogodilo, stoga je i izvorni njemački libreto Alfreda Marie Willnera, s naslovom Der Eisenhammer, na hrvatski preveo Ferdo Živko Miler naslovivši djelo Oganj. Prvi je put uprizorena 12. siječnja 1911. godine u Hrvatskome narodnom kazalištu u Zagrebu, a zagrebačka publika, kao i kritika, izvedbu je dočekala s oduševljenjem. Antun Gustav Matoš nazvao je Oganj "prvom umjetničkom operom visokog i modernog stila koju stvori Hrvat", osobito hvaleći "briljantni orkestralni dio", Josip Andrić ocijenio je da "stoji dostojno među djelima što ih je europska glazba dobila u doba prije četvrt stoljeća", a Lujo Šafranek-Kavić nazvao je Bersu "inspiriranim majstorom koji savršeno vlada čitavim aparatom". Opera je na izvorniku (pra)izvedena tek 2003. godine u Hrvatskom narodnom kazalištu u Zagrebu. Ova koncertna izvedba u povodu 150. obljetnice njegova ...

programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Opera is the most expensive theatrical species related to large ensembles that Croatian National Theater in Zagreb, Rijeka, Split and Osijek have. Apart from them, Croatian folk theaters also have the cities of Varazdin and Sibenik, but they are without an orchestra, vocal soloists and choirs. Therefore, their production of opera titles are seeking additional financial and organizational efforts that the Varazdin CNT has been decided lately, led by Intendant Senka Bulic. On the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the death of the opera genius Giacoma Puccini, it sets his poignant "Madam Butterfly", but not to remain only in Varaždin, co -produced with the Marin Držić City Theater in Dubrovnik, where the work is performed half a year later, in October 2024. The orchestra of musicians from Varaždin, Zagreb and Maribor, and his assistant Sofia Cingula was prepared by the Chamber Choir of the University of the North. There is left on director Marin Blažević and his team, as well as on young, mostly Varaždin and Rijeka soloists: soprano Anamarija Knego (Cio Cio San), Tenor Bože Jurić Pesic (Pinkerton), Bariton Jurica Jurasic Kapun (Sharpless/Bonzo/Il Commissionaro), MezzoSoSopranica Doro Jana Karrić (SUZUKA) Tenor Mislav Lucić (Goro) and soprano Gabriela Hrženjak (Kate Pinkerton). An important part of the production is the youngest students of the Varaždin Theater Studio of Youth, led by boy Vita Godec ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Opera je najskuplja kazališna vrsta vezana za velike ansamble kakvima raspolažu Hrvatska narodna kazališta u Zagrebu, Rijeci, Splitu i Osijeku. U povodu 100. obljetnice smrti opernoga genija Giacoma Puccinija postavlja njegovu potresnu "Madamu Butterfly", ali da ne ostane sve samo na Varaždinu, ušlo se u koprodukciju s Gradskim kazalištem Marina Držića u Dubrovniku gdje se djelo izvodi pola godine kasnije, u listopadu 2024. Za prvu izvedbu jedne Puccinijeve opere u Varaždinu maestro Ivan Hut okupio je orkestar glazbenika iz Varaždina, Zagreba i Maribora, a njegova asistentica Sofija Cingula pripremila je Komorni zbor Sveučilišta Sjever. Ostalo je na redatelju Marinu Blaževiću i njegovu timu, kao i na mladim, mahom varaždinskim i riječkim solistima: sopranistica Anamarija Knego (Cio Cio San), tenor Bože Jurić Pešić (Pinkerton), bariton Jurica Jurasić Kapun (Sharpless/Bonzo/Il Commissario), mezzosopranistica Dora Jana Klarić (Suzuki), tenor Mislav Lucić (Goro) i sopranistica Gabriela Hrženjak (Kate Pinkerton). programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Bosko Petrovic is the basic landmark and central figure of our modern jazz. As a musician and composer, Boskov is the importance of evident: there are countless recordings, with the feathers of jazz domestic and international, today equally glad to be listened to, and there is a rich author's oeuvre that continue to interpret new generations of musicians. These new generations, however, remind us of Bosko educators, which represents the cornerstone of our today's jazz scene: numerous active musicians and musicians today are shaped under its influence, which may be the most beautiful form of duration - through their own students and music offspring. Of course, there are Bosnia's companions, which continue to mark his incomparable contribution to our jazz. In this sense, the program "Jazz Continuo" is set aside in 2012, launched by Mario Mavrin, Primož Grašič and Vid Jamnik. This year's "Jazz Continuo" was held on January 15th in the small hall of V. Lisinski, was of particular importance because it was marked 90 years from Bosk's birth. In addition to Mavrina on bass guitars and peas guitars, David Gazarov and Emil Spanyi on the piano and Cristophe Bras on drums performed on this occasion. The program was made up of Bosk's own compositions and his favorite standards, and the performances of his friends and close associates confirmed that Bosk's importance would last as long as jazz lasts ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Boško Petrović osnovni je orijentir i središnja figura našeg modernog jazza. Kao muzičara i kompozitora, Boškova je važnost evidentna: tu su nebrojene snimke, s perjanicama jazza domaćim i međunarodnim, danas podjednako rado slušane, a tu je i bogat autorski opus koji nastavljaju interpretirati nove generacije muzičara. Te nas nove generacije pak podsjećaju na Boška pedagoga, koji predstavlja kamen temeljac naše današnje jazz scene: brojne danas aktivne muzičarke i muzičari oblikovani su pod njegovim utjecajem, što je možda i najljepši oblik trajanja - kroz vlastite učenike i glazbene potomke. Naravno, tu su i Boškovi suputnici, koji nastavljaju obilježavati njegov neusporedivi doprinos našem jazzu. U tom se smislu izdvaja program "Jazz continuo" koji su 2012. godine pokrenuli Mario Mavrin, Primož Grašič i Vid Jamnik. Ovogodišnji je "Jazz continuo", održan 15. siječnja u Maloj Dvorani V. Lisinskog, bio od posebnog značaja jer se njime obilježilo 90. godina od Boškovog rođenja. Uz Mavrina na bas gitari i Grašiča gitari, tim su povodom nastupili David Gazarov i Emil Spanyi na klaviru te Cristophe Bras na bubnjevima. Program je bio sastavljen od Boškovih vlastitih kompozicija i omiljenih mu standarda, a izvedbe njegovih prijatelja i bliskih suradnika potvrdile su da će Boškova važnost trajati dok god traje jazz u nas...

programme.title: Clint Eastwood, Last Hollywood Legend / Clint Eastwood, posljednja holivudska legenda
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood, La Dernière Legend - (Doc. Film, France, 2022) Clint Eastwood's career, born in 1930, begins in the 1950s and covers the 70th anniversary of the history of cinema. Over the decades, he has embodied a number of cult characters that cover all the genres and have turned it into a myth. His professional journey went from television actor to cynical cowboy spaghetti westerns, from the frowned inspector Harry to a valued filmmaker, from the popular hero to a star of the Elite, from the American cinema monument to the old man of the workaholic. In that face, it seemed to the unique wrinkles very quickly the rights of the epic was imprinted. They gave him a famous smile recognizable among a thousand frowned faces. Today, this is an unforgettable face as if it were carved in a rock and it was as if it had always been there, as if the whole history of America had passed like a country. The countries whose last legend is. In the rhythm of the romantic saga, the documentary is accompanied by Eastwood's career like Rijeka, not forgetting all her traps. No one believed in this young debut of the 1950s in Hollywood. It was a little missing that Eastwood had only a television cowboy forever, that Sergio Leone did not hire him for his spaghetti westerns just because he was cheap. No one believed in him or as a director when he started making his own films in the 1970s, quickly introducing a humanistic dimension and exploring the fragile manhood that went against his kitten and "back" image of the time. R.: Clelia Cohen Ul.: Clint Eastwood (Self - Portrait Subject and Interviewee), Sarah -Jane Sauvegrain (narrator), Arnold Schwarzenegger (Self - Interviewee), Martin Scorsesese (Self - Interviewee), Meryl Streep (Self - interview) ... / Clint Eastwood, la dernière legende - (dok. film, Francuska, 2022) Karijera Clinta Eastwooda, rođenog 1930. godine, počinje pedesetih godina 20. stoljeća i pokriva 70 godina povijesti kinematografije. Tijekom više desetljeća utjelovio je niz kultnih likova koji obuhvaćaju sve žanrove i koji su ga pretvorili u mit. Njegov profesionalni put išao je od televizijskog glumca do ciničnog kauboja špageti vesterna, od namrštenog inspektora Harryja do cijenjenog filmaša, od popularnog heroja do zvijezde koju preziru elite, od spomenika američke kinematografije do starca radoholičara. U to lice kao da se zahvaljujući jedinstvenim borama vrlo brzo utisnula prava epopeja. One su mu dale slavan osmijeh prepoznatljiv među tisuću namrštenih lica. Danas to svima nezaboravno lice kao da je uklesano u stijenu i kao da je oduvijek tu, kao da je prošlo cijelu povijest Amerike poput neke zemlje. Zemlje čija je on posljednja legenda. U ritmu romantične sage dokumentarni film prati Eastwoodovu karijeru nalik na rijeku ne zaboravljajući sve njezine zamke. U tog mladog debitanta pedesetih godina 20. stoljeća u Hollywoodu nitko nije vjerovao. Malo je falilo da Eastwood zauvijek ostane tek televizijski kauboj, da ga Sergio Leone nije angažirao za svoje špageti vesterne samo zato što je bio jeftin. Nitko nije vjerovao u njega ni kao redatelja kada je sedamdesetih počeo snimati vlastite filmove, brzo uvodeći humanističku dimenziju i istražujući krhku muškost koja je išla protiv njegovog mačističkog i "nazadnjačkog" imidža toga vremena. programme.title: Garage / Garaža
programme.desc: Garage-(S08, Music. A show, Croatia, 2015) Jurica Podna, although he played with groups 220, Steam Roller, Azra, etc. band, 4 ace, many remember the most through the work from the late 70s and early 80s, at the time of the new wave. Then he leaves the steam roller and establishes the group airport and in 1979 releases the debut album "When they think I am full." In 1981, the second album "Tango Bango" was released and the hits "Put the Right Thing" and "Your Face" again. "Ordinary Love Songs" releases from the album of the same name a year later. "24 Hours a day", "Fratello" and other hits are from the album "Dukat and Pribada" from 1984. Over the years, through eight studio albums and a series of hits, the group leaves an indelible mark on the domestic scene. Almost 35 years after that song, they radiate and drive to dance as they did. At the same time, he remains the most loyal to his guitar and at the end of 2014 releases his second solo album of instrumental guitar music "All Stars". Also interesting is the list of guests playing on that album: Branimir Johnny Stulic, Hus, Massimo, Neno Belan, Niksa Bratos, Vedran Bozic, Zeleni Lipovaca ... In the garage they perform songs: Friendly Fire, near you in darkness, Fratello, 24sata, lift me up high, put the right thing in the right place ... / Garaža - (S08, glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2015) Juricu Pađena, iako je svirao s grupama 220, Parni valjak, Azra, ITD bend, 4 asa, mnogi pamte najviše kroz rad s kraja 70-ih i početka 80-ih, u vrijeme novog vala. Tada napušta Parni valjak i osniva grupu Aerodrom te 1979. objavljuje debi album "Kad misli mi vrludaju". Godine 1981. izlazi drugi album "Tango Bango" i opet hitovi "Stavi pravu stvar" i "Tvoje lice". "Obične ljubavne pjesme" s istoimenog albuma objavljuju samo godinu dana poslije. "24 sata dnevno", "Fratello" i ostali hitovi su s albuma "Dukat i pribadače" iz 1984. Tijekom godina, kroz osam studijskih albuma i nizom hitova, grupa ostavlja neizbrisiv trag na domaćoj sceni. Gotovo 35 godina poslije te pjesme jednako zrače i tjeraju na ples kao i u vrijeme kada su nastale. Pađen istodobno ostaje najvjerniji svojoj gitari i krajem 2014. objavljuje svoj drugi samostalni album instrumentalne gitarske glazbe "All Stars". Zanimljiv je i popis gostiju koji su svirali na tom albumu: Branimir Johnny Štulić, Hus, Massimo, Neno Belan, Nikša Bratoš, Vedran Božić, Zele Lipovača... U Garaži izvode pjesme: Prijateljska vatra, Kraj tebe u tami, Fratello, 24sata, Digni me visoko, Stavi pravu stvar na pravo mjesto...

Her mother Joanne (K. Wareing) is a rough, irresponsible and promiscuous woman, constantly eager for fun, who does not care at all about Mia or her unlucky younger sister Tyler (R. Griffiths). Mia is not surprised at all when Joanne brings home a new boyfriend, an apparent and mysterious Connor (M. Fassbender). She notes that Connor is trying to always be at hand and help her in different situations. She will soon realize that Connor develops a relationship with her that is not a parental. At the same time, she begins to care for a white horse tied at a nearby dump, which she would like to save. Njezina majka Joanne (K. Wareing) gruba je, neodgovorna i promiskuitetna žena neprestano željna zabave, koja nimalo ne skrbi ni o Miji ni o njezinoj neodgojenoj mlađoj sestri Tyler (R. Griffiths). Mia se nimalo ne iznenadi kad Joanne jednog dana kući dovede novog dečka, naočitog i zagonetnog Connora (M. Fassbender). Primjećuje da se Connor trudi uvijek joj biti pri ruci i pomagati joj u različitim situacijama. Ubrzo će shvatiti da Connor s njom razvija odnos koji baš i nije roditeljski. Istodobno, ona počinje skrbiti o bijelom konju privezanom na obližnjem smetlištu, kojeg bi željela spasiti. programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) Bosko Petrovic is the basic landmark and central figure of our modern jazz. As a musician and composer, Boskov is the importance of evident: there are countless recordings, with the feathers of jazz domestic and international, today equally glad to be listened to, and there is a rich author's oeuvre that continue to interpret new generations of musicians. These new generations, however, remind us of Bosko educators, which represents the cornerstone of our today's jazz scene: numerous active musicians and musicians today are shaped under its influence, which may be the most beautiful form of duration - through their own students and music offspring. Of course, there are Bosnia's companions, which continue to mark his incomparable contribution to our jazz. In this sense, the program "Jazz Continuo" is set aside in 2012, launched by Mario Mavrin, Primož Grašič and Vid Jamnik. This year's "Jazz Continuo" was held on January 15th in the small hall of V. Lisinski, was of particular importance because it was marked 90 years from Bosk's birth. In addition to Mavrina on bass guitars and peas guitars, David Gazarov and Emil Spanyi on the piano and Cristophe Bras on drums performed on this occasion. The program was made up of Bosk's own compositions and his favorite standards, and the performances of his friends and close associates confirmed that Bosk's importance would last as long as jazz lasts ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Boško Petrović osnovni je orijentir i središnja figura našeg modernog jazza. Kao muzičara i kompozitora, Boškova je važnost evidentna: tu su nebrojene snimke, s perjanicama jazza domaćim i međunarodnim, danas podjednako rado slušane, a tu je i bogat autorski opus koji nastavljaju interpretirati nove generacije muzičara. Te nas nove generacije pak podsjećaju na Boška pedagoga, koji predstavlja kamen temeljac naše današnje jazz scene: brojne danas aktivne muzičarke i muzičari oblikovani su pod njegovim utjecajem, što je možda i najljepši oblik trajanja - kroz vlastite učenike i glazbene potomke. Naravno, tu su i Boškovi suputnici, koji nastavljaju obilježavati njegov neusporedivi doprinos našem jazzu. U tom se smislu izdvaja program "Jazz continuo" koji su 2012. godine pokrenuli Mario Mavrin, Primož Grašič i Vid Jamnik. Ovogodišnji je "Jazz continuo", održan 15. siječnja u Maloj Dvorani V. Lisinskog, bio od posebnog značaja jer se njime obilježilo 90. godina od Boškovog rođenja. Uz Mavrina na bas gitari i Grašiča gitari, tim su povodom nastupili David Gazarov i Emil Spanyi na klaviru te Cristophe Bras na bubnjevima. Program je bio sastavljen od Boškovih vlastitih kompozicija i omiljenih mu standarda, a izvedbe njegovih prijatelja i bliskih suradnika potvrdile su da će Boškova važnost trajati dok god traje jazz u nas...

programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2022) Today we are talking about two new books by Croatian authors. One of them sighs already on the cover - "Ah". Dragan Jurak wrote an unusual book - a genre crossword puzzle of the film essay, poetry in prose, autobiography and letters without addressee. The guest at the Andrija Skare studio in the new collection returns to stories, clips from the lives of a population of one neighborhood, coincidences that can change their lives. On the cover is the illustration of Stipan Tadic and on it Super Andrew, a Siget Skyscraper, one of the symbols of the "new part of the city", which is the title and place of the story of Andrew Skara's story. Finally, a literary treat - critic Dario Grgic recalled Stefan Zweig, a famous Austrian writer between the two world wars, and a book that will be called "yesterday's world" and is symptomatic and during this time in which all that slides somewhat well in the past ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2022) Danas govorimo o dvije nove knjige hrvatskih autora. Jedna od njih uzdiše već na naslovnici - "Ah". Dragan Jurak napisao je neobičnu knjigu - žanrovski križanac filmskog eseja, poezije u prozi, autobiografije te pisma bez adresata. Gost u studiju Andrija Škare u novoj zbirci vraća se pričama, isječcima iz života stanovnika jednoga kvarta, slučajnostima koje mogu promijeniti život. Na naslovnici je ilustracija Stipana Tadića a na njoj Super Andrija, sigetski neboder, jedan od simbola "Novog dijela grada", a to je naslov i mjesto radnje priča Andrije Škare. I za kraj jedna književna poslastica - kritičar Dario Grgić prisjetio se Stefana Zweiga, slavnog austrijskog književnika između dva svjetska rata, a knjiga o kojoj će biti riječ zove se "Jučerašnji svijet" i simptomatična je i za ovo vrijeme u kojem sve ono dobro pomalo klizi u prošlost...
